name: Hedging
what: lowers commitment so it can be walked back
affordance: lowers commitment so the claim can be walked back later
mechanism: weakens the force of an assertion while keeping its content on the table — deniability without retraction
benign_reading: Hedges very often express genuine uncertainty — epistemic honesty, not evasion (Lakoff 1973). The tell is hedging where a commitment was asked for and available.
output_phrasing: this phrasing lowers commitment — the promise can be denied later

naming_events.source: classical figure catalogs; Peacham, The Garden of Eloquence (1577) — staged doubt
George Lakoff, 'Hedges: A Study in Meaning Criteria and the Logic of Fuzzy Concepts', Journal of Philosophical Logic 2
CoNLL-2010 Shared Task, 'Learning to Detect Hedges and their Scope'

specimens.quote: I believe nicotine is not addictive, yes.
specimens.speaker: William Campbell, President and CEO, Philip Morris USA
specimens.note: Under oath at the Waxman hearing, the 'I believe' wrapper converts a factual claim contradicted by Philip Morris's own suppressed research into an unfalsifiable statement of personal belief — perjury insulation; all s…

specimens.quote: I think the environmental impact of this disaster is likely to be very, very modest.
specimens.speaker: Tony Hayward, CEO, BP (Sky News interview during the Deepwater Horizon spill)
specimens.note: 'I think' plus 'likely to be' doubly lowers commitment on a minimizing forecast BP needed the public to accept mid-crisis, keeping the claim retractable — as it had to be when the spill became the largest in US history.

specimens.quote: I'm not sure of the exact date but I probably heard about Fast and Furious for the first time over the last few weeks.
specimens.speaker: Eric Holder, US Attorney General, testimony to the House Judiciary Committee
specimens.note: The stacked hedges keep the date claim walk-backable: when memos surfaced showing his office was briefed in July 2010, DOJ recharacterized rather than retracted the answer — exactly the deniability-without-retraction …

honest_twins.text: I think the standup moved to 3pm, but check the calendar invite before you head over.
honest_twins.note: Same 'i think' construction, but here it marks genuine uncertainty and the speaker immediately points the listener to a way to verify — epistemic honesty (the benign reading), not deniability: no commitment was asked for that the speaker is dodging.

honest_twins.text: To the best of my knowledge the outage never touched the payments tier — but I can only see the app-server logs, so ask infra to confirm.
honest_twins.note: 'To the best of my knowledge' honestly scopes the claim to the evidence the speaker actually has and names the limit of that evidence; the hedge invites checking rather than pre-building a walk-back.
